g.text: OVHcloud - Public Cloud project, region GRA (Gravelines, France)
Ansible, Terraform, OpenStack CLI,kubectl, Helm, Kustomize
Kubernetes control plane (managed by OVHcloud) - API6443 restricted to the bastion IP
Worker node software: OVHcloud MKS node image (Linux), kubelet, containerd
Node pool infra - b3-16, 2 to 10 nodes
Node pool rs_server - b3-16, up to 3 nodes
Node pool rs_env - b3-16, up to 3 nodes
Node pool prefect_flow - b3-16, 0 to 5 nodes
DPR Dask Clusters (EOPF CPM and DPR processors)
OVHcloud Object Storage (S3, region GRA) - public HTTPSendpoint

The dev cluster has the same node pools, software and deploymentas the ops cluster, with a smaller sizing. Intra-cluster flows(Envoy Gateway to the services, services to databases and Dask)use the Kubernetes pod network.
Copernicus stations (CADIP, AUXIP, PRIP)- HTTPS endpoints
